text:
Very special pass today for Dom with an excellent drive at Nelson Test Centre! 

Dom drove exceptionally well and passed with only two driver faults! 

All the dedication and determination paid off! 

Well done Dom! 

Now it's time to get you're car insured and mot'd and take your son out for a drive! 😀 🚗🎉🚦

And thank you for the card and gift! I'm sure I'll enjoy a couple of glasses of that over the weekend🤣
